title: Portfolio
text: My name is Romeo Velarde-Alvarez. I am a junior Engineering major at Harvey Mudd College focused on hardware electronics and RF/analog circuit design. I am building personal electronics and embedded systems projects to strengthen my skills in circuit design, microcontrollers, controls, and PCB design. Through team projects, I have gained experience in electronics, systems, and collaborative problem solving. I am a researcher in the Cell Biology, Microfluidics, and Tissue Engineering Lab, where I work on a team developing a multichannel bioprinter for complex tissue models.
